title.zh: 分布式光纤传感的基本原理

summary.zh: 从背向散射出发，理解 DAS、DTS 与 DSS 测到了什么，以及它们没有直接测到什么。
summary.en: Start with backscatter and understand what DAS, DTS, and DSS measure, and what still requires interpretation.

summary.zh: 套管外、油管上与临时下入：布设位置决定能观测什么，也决定怎样解释。
summary.en: Behind casing, on tubing, or temporarily conveyed: placement shapes both the observation and its interpretation.

title.en: The life cycle of an oil and gas well

summary.zh: 从设计、钻井与完井，到生产、修井和封井：把监测问题放回真实的作业阶段。
summary.en: From design and drilling to operation, intervention, and closure: put each monitoring question in its operational context.

summary.zh: 从拉曼强度比出发，分点介绍温度测量、单端与双端标定，以及布里渊、瑞利测温的条件。
summary.en: Start with Raman intensity ratios, then explore temperature sensing, single/double-ended calibration, and the conditions for Brillouin/Rayleigh thermometry.

summary.zh: 分点理解分布式声学传感：测到了什么、怎样获得信号、有哪些代表性实现，以及如何解释。
summary.en: Understand distributed acoustic sensing point by point: observations, acquisition, representative implementations, and interpretation.

summary.zh: 从拉曼强度比出发，分点介绍温度测量、单端与双端标定，以及布里渊、瑞利测温的条件。
summary.en: Start with Raman intensity ratios, then explore temperature sensing, single/double-ended calibration, and the conditions for Brillouin/Rayleigh thermometry.

summary.zh: 分点理解布里渊和瑞利应变测量，比较时域、频域与相关域定位，并说明温度补偿和应变传递。
summary.en: Understand Brillouin and Rayleigh strain sensing, compare time/frequency/correlation localization, and examine temperature compensation and strain transfer.
